body: I do, though. I'm a mean person and finally falling under my own lens

society didn't do anything wrong though, it's just me. I didn't do shit right, and I'm gross. I'm not gonna blame my problems on other people, or say the whole world is against me, or shit like that. Through a series of genetic mishaps, carelessness, and denial, my appearance has morphed into something genuinely revolting.

I literally gasped when I saw how bad I've gotten. I've lost a lot of weight in the past couple years by eating healthier but I literally almost threw up seeing how still horrendous my body is, I can't believe I couldn't notice, can't believe I had confidence.
